subject.title: fix(agents): extend thinking error recovery to body, detail, and responseBody carriers

question: Should OpenClaw broaden Anthropic thinking recovery beyond the canonical `errorBody` field to accept the generic string carriers `body`, `detail`, and `responseBody`?
rationale: The code is mechanically narrow, but the accepted error-carrier contract determines whether these fields are safe recovery signals or overly broad wrapper heuristics.

options.title: Accept the three string carriers
options.body: Confirm the expanded carrier contract, then require a rebased branch and runtime proof that a new carrier retries once and returns a recovered result.

options.title: Keep only canonical provider fields
options.body: Decline the broader wrapper fields and retain the merged `errorBody` behavior unless a concrete production wrapper establishes a new canonical carrier.

recommendation.title: Accept the three string carriers
recommendation.body: Confirm the expanded carrier contract, then require a rebased branch and runtime proof that a new carrier retries once and returns a recovered result.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged carrier behavior that defines the closest existing recovery contract.
